## Checklist

- [ ] Conventional Commit message, `Signed-off-by:` trailer (DCO)
- [ ] Tests cover the new behaviour
- [ ] `contracts/openapi-v1.json` regenerated **only** if the change is intentional
- [ ] Migrations included and reversible
- [ ] New user-visible strings wrapped in `{% translate %}` / `gettext`
- [ ] No box-drawing diagrams (see `docs/style-guide.md`)
- [ ] Docs updated, including `docs/claims.md` if a claim changed
